column1: # Per-record free-translation repairs that cannot be inferred from shape alone.
# POL-039: the data lives here, not in python.
# action = note     the SECOND same-language line is metalinguistic commentary,
#                   not a translation: it moves to @notes on the first.
# action = drop_all every translation is removed from the sentence -- the record's
#                   translations belong to a larger span than this S covers.
# action = unwrap   (record *, lang eng) every English translation in the story
#                   that is wrapped whole in one pair of quotation marks loses
#                   the pair. The story's translator wrapped (almost) every
#                   translation -- anhi 7 of 7, frog5 92 of 92, frog1 56 of 57,
#                   holiday 103 of 105 -- so the marks say nothing, but the
#                   quote cleaner read them as evidence of a quotation
#                   (maintainer, 2026-10-14). Elsewhere a wrapped translation
#                   is the speaker's own words and is left alone.
